name: Sovjonok
source: A young man named Alexander has been suffering from nightmares for months now, which he can't even remember. He lives his usual life, full of melancholy and apathy due to the loss of a close friend. One day, in order to somehow unwind and distract himself from bad thoughts, Sasha is planning to go on a trip to one place, but either by the will of fate or thanks to someone's bad plan, he ends up somewhere completely different. The "Sovenok" so familiar to us, however, is completely different, full of horror and nightmares. Alexander has to figure out what happened here and survive while trying not to perish in the abyss of his own madness...
